Department of Health and Human Services.title: CMS-64 FY2024 federal Medicaid share by state and service
Department of Health and Human Services.basis: Final FY2024 CMS-64 reports total $612,391,730,046 of federal medical-assistance and administration share. States below $10B remain whole; 22 larger states are expanded into service categories of at least $1B plus an exact below-$1B residual. Thirteen annual service rows remain above $10B because CMS does not publicly release the category-of-service quarters; they are labeled public annual disclosure ceilings rather than divided or prorated. This actual-expenditure source view remains $5,125,269,954 below the MTS cash row and is not added to it.
Department of Health and Human Services.sourceLabel: CMS MBES/CBES FY2024 Financial Management Report

Department of Health and Human Services.title: CMS FY2024 federal CHIP share by state and territory
Department of Health and Human Services.basis: CMS's final FY2024 Financial Management Report provides federal-share totals for Medicaid-expansion CHIP, qualifying-state CHIP-funded Medicaid, and separate CHIP. Combining those three mutually exclusive program sections by geography yields 56 rows and $20.018974226B. State-reported CMS-21 expenditure timing and scope differ from Treasury's $19.449B Children's Health Insurance Fund net cash outlay, so this is a separate operational view rather than an additive child.
Department of Health and Human Services.sourceLabel: CMS MBES/CBES FY2024 CHIP Financial Management Report
